messages:
Iris: kicking off the release notes draft for the docs push. Items: adaptive routing public beta, migration notes for pinned model variants, console rollout copy tweak, and a short Known Issues with repro. Need parity of SDK snippets (py/ts/go), a 3-step migration checklist, and link fixes. 
Hector: i'll sweep python + curl. drop the PR link? 
Iris: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5179 branch `release/docs-adaptive-beta` — please comment inline. 
Sam: i'll handle TS + Go. heads-up: `retry_policy` was consolidated into `fallback_policy` and now accepts an object. will update samples. 
Lena: found two 404 anchors in migration guide (`#pin-model` and `#kv-cache-notes`). i'll add redirects in the PR. 
Hector: python snippet tweak: fallback_policy must be mapping, not string. proposing:

``
client.generate(
  model="kestrel-1",
  input="Hello",
  fallback_policy={"type": "model_variant", "priority": ["low_latency", "low_cost"]}
)
```

Lena: added a short reusable cURL example for the repro steps and replaced raw githubusercontent links with docs permalinks. 
Sam: added TS repro steps and a tiny Go sample. QA note: in TS the `fallback_policy` shape uses camelCase in the SDK; watch for naming differences. 
Iris: Known Issues copy suggestion: "p99 latency can spike during mixed long+short bursts; repro steps included in migration guide." Can someone craft the single-line repro? 
Sam: single-line repro added in PR comment: "Repro: staging -> send one 4k+ token request followed immediately by 8 concurrent 16-32 token requests; observe p99." 
Hector: quick CI catch: an old 'embed-streaming' deprecation note still referenced on the embeddings page. adding a cross-link from the changelog to the deprecation doc. 
docbot: Staging preview deployed for PR #5179. Snippet render check: OK. Anchor check: 2 redirects present. 
Lena: migration checklist (3 steps) pushed: 1) Update pinned mapping in model catalog; 2) Test routing in staging with representative traffic; 3) Monitor p99+errors for 24h and rollback if anomalies. 
Iris: timeline: merge by tomorrow midday. please add approvals once QA passes so i can schedule publish and the slack announcement. :rocket: 
Hector: will run the py snippet on staging tomorrow and post latency/token numbers. 
Sam: minor nit: change 'pin' wording to 'pin (legacy)' where we explain deprecation. pushed commit. 
Lena: approved after small link fix. 
Hector: approved pending QA metrics. 
Iris: perfect, thanks everyone — i'll merge after final green and post the release blurb. :tada:
